newsitem.title: USA: Diana's Sattel unit posts Q2 oper profit.
newsitem.headline: Diana's Sattel unit posts Q2 oper profit.

text.p: Diana Corp said on Wednesday its Sattel Communications subsidiary had an operating profit of $99,000, or $0.02 a share, in its fiscal second quarter.
Sattel, which Diana plans to keep while spinning off its other businesses, generated sales of $4.0 million in the second quarter ended October 12.
The results were in line with the company's expectations.

No year-earlier earnings or sales comparisons were available. But the company said Sattel's business activities increased during the quarter as it shipped more DSS telecommunications switches to Concentric Network Corp to support the rollout of its nationwide Internet network.

"In addition, we shipped the first of several switches to a new international long-distance provider, and shipped equipment to new domestic long-distance providers," James Fiedler, chairman of Diana and Sattel, said in a statement.
Earlier Wednesday, Diana reported a loss from continuing operations for the second quarter of $0.12 a share, compared with a year-ago loss of $0.07.
